g.text: Style customization | 100-1,000 images | shared pool of 2-4 GPUs
One stage per GPU; one current attempt per job
Online serving fleet is outside scope
Queue age / GPU use / lease loss
All GPU stages share one finite pool
Logical components may share a process; registry is backed by PostgreSQL + object storage.
GPU class cycle: EVALUATE, TRAIN, CAPTION, TRAIN; fair user rotation within each class.
Lost leases fence results; unconfirmed devices quarantine until termination is confirmed.
DESIGN PROPOSAL | Model / hardware neutral | No measured throughput or quality claims
